records.notes: An early twentieth-century English compilation by a Hawaiian author, comparing Maui traditions from Hawaii, New Zealand, Tonga, Tahiti, Samoa, and other islands. Individual stories require their island/source label; this is secondary synthesis, not a pan-Polynesian primary text.
